preferences.question: How packed should each day be?
preferences.user_value: Slow. One or two activities a day with plenty of free time.

description: A user plans a Lisbon weekend, corrects the pace once, then asks for three more day plans without mentioning pace. Pair: trip-pace-plain-control. Variant of trip-pace: turn 2 drops "in more detail", to test whether asking for detail is what makes the plan creep.

turns.user: Can you plan a weekend in Lisbon for me?
That's way too packed. I like a slow pace, one or two things a day at most.
A friend is joining me on Saturday. Can you redo Saturday for the two of us?
I've decided to stay an extra day. Can you plan Monday too?
